subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly tokens + peak TPS
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly tokens + peak TPS — post-call recap

Thanks again for your time today, Jane — great to learn more about how Acme's new personalization feature will use generation on product pages. Quick recap and a couple of follow-ups so we can get you a Hosted API quote that matches your cost targets:

- Usage profile (what we discussed):
  • Estimated monthly token volume: ~500M tokens
  • Peak concurrent/throughput target: ~20-25 TPS during promotional spikes
  • 95th percentile sustained TPS expected: ~10-12 TPS
- Quality requirement: generation latency under 1s per request for perceived UX
- Target unit economics you mentioned: target ~$15 / 1M tokens (goal to get to $7k–$10k/month)

Can you confirm the above numbers? Two quick clarifying items that will affect pricing: 1) percent of requests that are short (<256 tokens) vs long (>1k tokens), and 2) whether you need guaranteed latency SLA (we can include Dedicated pricing if so).

Next steps: if numbers above are accurate, I’ll pull together a Hosted API pricing sheet with projected monthly cost, expected throttling behavior at peak, and recommended rate limits. If you want, we can also schedule a short tech call next week with Alex to validate concurrency and caching opportunities.

Attachments: I attached a blank usage spreadsheet to capture token breakdowns (acme_usage_estimates.xlsx).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly tokens + peak TPS — post-call recap

Hi Ben — thanks for the summary. Confirming the rough numbers from our side after pulling logs and recent load tests:

- Expected monthly token volume: ~500,000,000 tokens (we expect growth into Q3)
- Typical request size: ~350 tokens average; 80% of requests are <512 tokens, 10% are >1k tokens
- Peak TPS during marketing pushes: around 25 TPS for short bursts (~10–15 minutes), sustained peak (95p) ~12 TPS
- Target unit economics: around $15 / 1M tokens (this is our internal target)
- Approx budget target: $7k–$10k / month initially (flexible if unit cost is lower)

We don't require an SLA for the proof-of-concept but will want latency guarantees at scale for production.

Happy to take a technical call with Alex next week — Thurs or Fri morning PST works.

Best,
Jane Doe
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
jane.doe@acme.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-02-27T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly tokens + peak TPS — follow-ups

Appreciate the confirmation, Jane — those numbers are super helpful. A few follow-ups so we can model precise unit economics and drop you an initial quote:

1) Can you confirm average token per "generate" vs token per full request? (e.g., prompt tokens + completion tokens average) — you gave ~350 average which helps, but we typically model separately for prompt vs completion to estimate per-call variance.
2) Do you plan to use streaming responses? That can affect latency and billing visibility for you.
3) For the promotional spikes (25 TPS), is it acceptable to handle via autoscale (best-effort) or do you need guaranteed capacity? If guaranteed, we should consider Dedicated/reserved capacity pricing.

Proposed next step: Alex and I can run an internal model (based on your 500M tokens and 25 TPS peak) and send a Hosted API projected cost table including: monthly cost @ $/1M token bands (e.g., $20, $15, $10), expected token cost, estimated request latency ranges, and recommended config (batching + prefix caching).

I'll also loop in our pricing lead (Marissa) to confirm if we can hit your $15 / 1M target at 500M volume and whether any promotional discount applies for an annual commit.

Can we schedule Thurs 10:30 AM PST for the tech sync?

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-03-04T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly tokens + peak TPS — Acme (quote request)

Marissa — forwarding the confirmed numbers from Acme (they're the PM for personalization). TL;DR:

- 500M tokens / month expected
- Average ~350 tokens per request (80% <512, 10% >1k)
- Peak bursts ~25 TPS (10–15 minute bursts), 95p sustained ~12 TPS
- Target ~$15 / 1M tokens, budget $7k–$10k/mo initially

Can you please run a hosted cost model and let me know: 1) can we hit their $15 / 1M at 500M volume with any commit level or promotional discount, 2) suggested quote for month-to-month vs 12-month annual commit, and 3) whether we should propose Hosted API or Dedicated (given 25 TPS bursts and future growth). I attached their usage spreadsheet and a draft pricing pdf (acme_usage_estimates.xlsx, draft_pricing_quote.pdf).

If we can hit $15 / 1M with a modest 6–12 month commit, they should be able to close at $8k/mo. Otherwise we should present a short path to Dedicated with guaranteed capacity for peak windows.

Thanks — can we aim to have a draft quote by EOD Friday so I can share on Thurs call?

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
